manifest.notes: Marginalia (x.com/marginalia_md): notes in the margin of every trade. Ethereum mainnet MARG/IMD. Marginalia is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. MarginaliaHook validates flags 0x20cc; callbacks require PoolManager. beforeInitialize requires the supplied factory and fee 12500, binds its first pool and refuses later pools. No liquidity callbacks restrict seeding, withdrawals or LP fee claims. No owner, admin, pause, upgrade or setter. The constructor creates and initializes EIP-1167 clones of launch #1240 implementations pinned in MarginaliaImpls.sol: Router 0x365ccb3cfbc430600485234f56fd5ecb23fd70d1, Judge 0xc93460730a79a22282f063a0c6ba5e340ac372b4, Treasury 0xe2086012f5f9cc7caecdbc70de392e263aae8481. Stateless Pricer 0xeaff9b262341a0cb05579227e662bfe768a71cfb is called by staticcall. Do not redeploy these implementations. Construction requires no existing chain state; missing implementation code makes operational companion calls revert. Buys have no hook fee. Noted MARG sells pay 1% plus a 0.1 IMD stamp; quiet sells pay 3% and require exact input. Note data is accepted only from the hook's router. Fees, stamps and forfeits remain IMD claims, split at accrual 70% to the week's thesis prize and 30% to the day's writer refund; never sold for ETH. The hook holds no MARG claims: potMarg() is zero. Noted buys spend 0.25 IMD on MARG plus the 0.1 IMD stamp and an author-sized 0.25-10 IMD bond. Noted sells bond 0.25 IMD from output. Calls on tokens other than IMD target a move of at least 10% over 1-90 days on canonical v4/v3/v2 venues; text is limited to 280 bytes. Same-transaction X trades produce class Traded; contract authors are Agent. Target-zero theses allow 8192 bytes and require an author's child call within the 7-day grace period to avoid forfeiture; at most 120 theses per week, 3 per author. Rebuttals and opposite-side counter-calls retain separate bonds. Price calls require a router checkpoint aged 1-6 hours: v3/v2 accumulator TWAPs, adverse baseline extremes for v4 and the hub leg. A seal pays an additional non-refundable stamp, snapshots both baselines and the author's X balance, and binds the author, X and venue. Reveals at 30 minutes through 6 hours use the sealed baseline; sealed BUY balances may not fall. Lapsed seals retain their stamp in the pools. Permissionless observations run for 6 hours after the horizon: at least 3, spaced 20 blocks, spanning at least 1 hour; more adverse readings replace slots. Settlement uses v3/v2 first-to-last TWAPs with an adverse hub leg; v4 selects the least favourable complete observation price, keeping both legs from the same observation. BUY balance failures breach the hold rule; SELL settles on price alone. RIGHT returns the bonded IMD. VoidNoData returns the bond but scores wrong. WRONG, VoidSold and retractions forfeit; settling keepers receive 10% of forfeitures. Score adds log2(multiple) x sqrt(30/horizon) x market-cap tier x outcome (+1 right, -1 wrong/broken/unproven, -0.5 retracted) on every venue; reputation pays no pool rewards. Weekly thesis judging waits until week-end plus 7 days, requires at least 2 IMD and uses Intake 0x1397434cd35e8a9c8ac312a61d3a285eb31dea56 for an evidence-panel head of 3 (nominal price 0.5 IMD; the judge accepts Intake quotes up to 1 IMD), paying 50/30/20; empty eligible rankings roll forward. Non-retracted daily notes share refunds capped at one stamp; later retractions do not claw back paid refunds. Unclaimed pools sweep forward after 28 days. Treasury drips 2% of held IMD daily. Existing limits: pair and tick spacing are supplied by the factory, not pinned by the hook; the judge relies on Intake request routing without comparing questionHash. The mainnet fork rehearsal requires MAINNET_RPC_URL and was not run here because it was unavailable.
